race.comment: SURROUND ME (7) is yet to win this prep but her form has been solid. Picked up nicely in the closing stages to finish fourth last start over 1300m at Belmont. Has a win and a placing from two Bunbury appearances and looks ready to win again. YAMASHITA'S GOLD (1) came from a long way back in a big field to get up for third last time out over this course and distance. Probably goes back again from a wide draw but watch for him in the final stages. COSMIC TREAT (11) led for the judge but had nothing left in the run home over 1400m at Belmont recently. Suited coming back in trip and gets a little weight so she can offer a bit more resistance this time. GUARANTOR (3) didn't quicken as hoped and missed the frame over 1000m at Belmont last time. Might be looking for 1200m now. RUN PATTIE RUN (8) flashed home for second in a comparable race here last start. Cherry ripe at the fourth run back and is capable of another big run.
